title: How is ginger good for us
titleChinese: 生姜对健康有哪些益处
paragraphs: It's normal for our bodies to not always be in tip-top condition, whether we catch the flu, have aching muscles after lots of exercise or get travel sick. But there's an ingredient that can help with all of that, and it can be used in all sorts of ways.

Ginger isn't just something to have in the kitchen – it's been used as an aid for centuries. Research consistently shows it eases nausea, such as motion sickness, and is recommended as a remedy by the NHS for helping ease pregnancy sickness. Anna Daniels, a dietitian and spokesperson for the British Dietetic Association, says it's so beneficial because it has "powerful anti-inflammatory properties which assist with reducing inflammation in the gastrointestinal tract and therefore relieve discomfort and settle upset stomachs."

And it can help with more than just nausea. Ginger tea has been shown to help fight colds and flu because it encourages perspiration, which in turn reduces feverish symptoms. Gingerol, a bioactive compound in the spice, has been found to help reduce the risk of infections because it supports immune health, including autoimmune conditions such as rheumatoid arthritis and lupus. And if you're sporty, there's good news for you too. Studies by the International Journal of Preventative Medicine and The Journal of Pain found that a daily supplement of ginger eased muscle soreness after intense physical activity.

So, how can you use ginger? It's an incredibly versatile ingredient and can be used in almost anything from tea to biscuits to fiery stir-fries. Many cafes and supermarkets now sell ginger shots promoting health benefits. Emily Jonzen, author of The Goodness of Ginger and Turmeric, suggests grating it, though she advises "it has a strong flavour and a fieriness to it so introduce it to your cooking a little at a time".
So, if you like the taste, you could incorporate it into your diet and see if you feel these health benefits.

vocabulary.entry: **tip-top** /ˌtɪp ˈtɒp/ adj. 极好的，一流的（口语）
vocabulary.example: The hotel was in tip-top condition.
vocabulary.translation: 这家酒店状况极佳。

vocabulary.entry: **flu** /fluː/ n. 流感
vocabulary.example: She was in bed with the flu.
vocabulary.translation: 她因流感卧床不起。

vocabulary.entry: **aching** /ˈeɪkɪŋ/ adj. 疼痛的，酸痛的
vocabulary.example: She had aching muscles after her first workout.
vocabulary.translation: 第一次锻炼后她肌肉酸痛。

vocabulary.entry: **travel sick** /ˈtrævl sɪk/ adj. 晕车的，晕船的（固定表达）
vocabulary.example: I always get travel sick on long bus journeys.
vocabulary.translation: 我乘坐长途巴士时总是晕车。

vocabulary.entry: **ingredient** /ɪnˈɡriːdiənt/ n. 成分，原料
vocabulary.example: The list of ingredients includes flour, sugar, and eggs.
vocabulary.translation: 成分列表包括面粉、糖和鸡蛋。

vocabulary.entry: **consistently** /kənˈsɪstəntli/ adv. 一贯地，始终如一地（书面语）
vocabulary.example: The team has performed consistently well this season.
vocabulary.translation: 本赛季这支队伍的表现一直很好。

vocabulary.entry: **nausea** /ˈnɔːziə/ n. 恶心（书面语）
vocabulary.example: The medication may cause nausea as a side effect.
vocabulary.translation: 这种药物可能引起恶心的副作用。

vocabulary.entry: **motion sickness** /ˈməʊʃn ˌsɪknəs/ n. 晕动病，晕车/船（固定表达）
vocabulary.example: Some people take medication to prevent motion sickness.
vocabulary.translation: 有些人服用药物来预防晕车。

vocabulary.entry: **remedy** /ˈremədi/ n. 疗法，药品（书面语）
vocabulary.example: A hot drink is a good remedy for a cold.
vocabulary.translation: 热饮是治疗感冒的好方法。

vocabulary.entry: **dietitian** /ˌdaɪəˈtɪʃn/ n. 营养师，膳食学家（书面语）
vocabulary.example: The dietitian advised her to eat more fruit and vegetables.
vocabulary.translation: 营养师建议她多吃水果和蔬菜。

vocabulary.entry: **anti-inflammatory** /ˌænti ɪnˈflæmətri/ adj. 抗炎的（专业术语，书面语）
vocabulary.example: Turmeric is known for its anti-inflammatory properties.
vocabulary.translation: 姜黄以其抗炎特性而闻名。

vocabulary.entry: **gastrointestinal tract** /ˌɡæstrəʊɪnˈtestɪnl trækt/ n. 胃肠道（专业术语）
vocabulary.example: The drug is absorbed through the gastrointestinal tract.
vocabulary.translation: 这种药物通过胃肠道吸收。

vocabulary.entry: **relieve** /rɪˈliːv/ v. 缓解，减轻
vocabulary.example: The medicine helped relieve his pain.
vocabulary.translation: 这种药帮助缓解了他的疼痛。

vocabulary.entry: **upset stomach** /ˌʌpset ˈstʌmək/ n. 肠胃不适，胃部不适（固定表达）
vocabulary.example: Eating too much rich food can give you an upset stomach.
vocabulary.translation: 吃太多油腻的食物会导致肠胃不适。

vocabulary.entry: **perspiration** /ˌpɜːspəˈreɪʃn/ n. 汗液，出汗（书面语）
vocabulary.example: Perspiration dripped from his forehead.
vocabulary.translation: 汗水从他的额头上滴下来。

vocabulary.entry: **feverish** /ˈfiːvərɪʃ/ adj. 发烧的，发热的（书面语）
vocabulary.example: She felt feverish and had to lie down.
vocabulary.translation: 她感觉发烧，不得不躺下。

vocabulary.entry: **gingerol** /ˈdʒɪndʒərɒl/ n. 姜辣素（专业术语）
vocabulary.example: Gingerol gives ginger its characteristic pungent taste.
vocabulary.translation: 姜辣素赋予生姜特有的辛辣味道。

vocabulary.entry: **bioactive** /ˌbaɪəʊˈæktɪv/ adj. 生物活性的（专业术语，书面语）
vocabulary.example: Bioactive compounds in plants can have health benefits.
vocabulary.translation: 植物中的生物活性化合物可能对健康有益。

vocabulary.entry: **compound** /ˈkɒmpaʊnd/ n. 化合物（书面语）
vocabulary.example: Sulphur dioxide is a compound of sulphur and oxygen.
vocabulary.translation: 二氧化硫是硫和氧的化合物。

vocabulary.entry: **infection** /ɪnˈfekʃn/ n. 感染
vocabulary.example: The wound became infected with bacteria.
vocabulary.translation: 伤口被细菌感染了。

vocabulary.entry: **immune health** /ɪˈmjuːn helθ/ n. 免疫健康（固定表达）
vocabulary.example: A balanced diet is important for immune health.
vocabulary.translation: 均衡饮食对免疫健康很重要。

vocabulary.entry: **autoimmune** /ˌɔːtəʊɪˈmjuːn/ adj. 自身免疫的（专业术语，书面语）
vocabulary.example: Rheumatoid arthritis is an autoimmune disease.
vocabulary.translation: 类风湿性关节炎是一种自身免疫性疾病。

vocabulary.entry: **rheumatoid arthritis** /ˌruːmətɔɪd ɑːˈθraɪtɪs/ n. 类风湿性关节炎（专业术语）
vocabulary.example: Rheumatoid arthritis causes joint pain and swelling.
vocabulary.translation: 类风湿性关节炎会导致关节疼痛和肿胀。

vocabulary.entry: **lupus** /ˈluːpəs/ n. 狼疮（专业术语，书面语）
vocabulary.example: Lupus is a chronic autoimmune disease that can affect many parts of the body.
vocabulary.translation: 狼疮是一种慢性自身免疫性疾病，可以影响身体的许多部位。

vocabulary.entry: **sporty** /ˈspɔːti/ adj. 爱好运动的，擅长运动的（口语）
vocabulary.example: She's a sporty person who enjoys running and swimming.
vocabulary.translation: 她是个喜欢运动的人，热爱跑步和游泳。

vocabulary.entry: **supplement** /ˈsʌplɪmənt/ n. 补充剂，增补物（书面语）
vocabulary.example: Vitamin supplements can help fill nutritional gaps.
vocabulary.translation: 维生素补充剂有助于填补营养缺口。

vocabulary.entry: **muscle soreness** /ˈmʌsl ˈsɔːnəs/ n. 肌肉酸痛（固定表达）
vocabulary.example: Muscle soreness is common after a new workout routine.
vocabulary.translation: 开始新的锻炼计划后肌肉酸痛是很常见的。

vocabulary.entry: **intense** /ɪnˈtens/ adj. 剧烈的，强烈的
vocabulary.example: The heat was so intense that we had to stay indoors.
vocabulary.translation: 天气太热了，我们不得不待在室内。

vocabulary.entry: **versatile** /ˈvɜːsətaɪl/ adj. 多功能的，多才多艺的（书面语）
vocabulary.example: This is a versatile kitchen tool that can chop, slice, and grate.
vocabulary.translation: 这是一个多功能厨房工具，可以切、切片和磨碎。

vocabulary.entry: **fiery** /ˈfaɪəri/ adj. 辛辣的，火辣的
vocabulary.example: The sauce has a fiery taste that lingers on the tongue.
vocabulary.translation: 这种酱汁有一种在舌尖久久不散的辛辣味道。

vocabulary.entry: **stir-fry** /ˈstɜː fraɪ/ n. 炒菜（尤指中式）
vocabulary.example: We had a vegetable stir-fry for dinner.
vocabulary.translation: 我们晚餐吃了炒蔬菜。

vocabulary.entry: **shot** /ʃɒt/ n. 一小杯饮料（尤指烈酒或浓缩健康饮品）
vocabulary.example: She ordered a ginger shot at the juice bar.
vocabulary.translation: 她在果汁吧点了一杯姜汁饮品。

vocabulary.entry: **grate** /ɡreɪt/ v. 磨碎（食物）
vocabulary.example: Grate the cheese over the pasta.
vocabulary.translation: 把奶酪磨碎撒在意大利面上。

vocabulary.entry: **incorporate** /ɪnˈkɔːpəreɪt/ v. 将……纳入，包含（书面语）
vocabulary.example: We should incorporate more vegetables into our diet.
vocabulary.translation: 我们应该在饮食中加入更多的蔬菜。

sentences.english: It's normal for our bodies to not always be in tip-top condition, whether we catch the flu, have aching muscles after lots of exercise or get travel sick.
sentences.chinese: 我们的身体并不总是处于最佳状态，无论是得了流感、大量运动后肌肉酸痛，还是晕车，这都是正常的。

sentences.english: But there's an ingredient that can help with all of that, and it can be used in all sorts of ways.
sentences.chinese: 但有一种成分可以帮助缓解所有这些不适，而且它可以以各种方式被使用。

sentences.english: Ginger isn't just something to have in the kitchen – it's been used as an aid for centuries.
sentences.chinese: 生姜不仅仅是厨房里的调味品——它作为治疗辅助品已有数百年历史。

sentences.english: Research consistently shows it eases nausea, such as motion sickness, and is recommended as a remedy by the NHS for helping ease pregnancy sickness.
sentences.chinese: 研究一致表明，它可以缓解恶心，例如晕动病，英国国家医疗服务体系也推荐将其作为缓解孕吐的疗法。

sentences.english: Anna Daniels, a dietitian and spokesperson for the British Dietetic Association, says it's so beneficial because it has "powerful anti-inflammatory properties which assist with reducing inflammation in the gastrointestinal tract and therefore relieve discomfort and settle upset stomachs."
sentences.chinese: 英国饮食协会发言人、营养师安娜·丹尼尔斯说，生姜之所以如此有益，是因为它具有"强大的抗炎特性，有助于减少胃肠道的炎症，从而缓解不适并安抚肠胃不适。"

sentences.english: And it can help with more than just nausea.
sentences.chinese: 还有，它不仅能帮助缓解恶心。

sentences.english: Ginger tea has been shown to help fight colds and flu because it encourages perspiration, which in turn reduces feverish symptoms.
sentences.chinese: 姜茶已被证明有助于对抗感冒和流感，因为它能促进排汗，从而减轻发烧症状。

sentences.english: Gingerol, a bioactive compound in the spice, has been found to help reduce the risk of infections because it supports immune health, including autoimmune conditions such as rheumatoid arthritis and lupus.
sentences.chinese: 姜辣素是姜这种香料中的一种生物活性化合物，已被发现有助于降低感染风险，因为它能强化免疫健康，包括类风湿性关节炎和狼疮等自身免疫性疾病。

sentences.english: And if you're sporty, there's good news for you too.
sentences.chinese: 如果你喜欢运动，同样也有好消息。

sentences.english: Studies by the International Journal of Preventative Medicine and The Journal of Pain found that a daily supplement of ginger eased muscle soreness after intense physical activity.
sentences.chinese: 《国际预防医学杂志》和《疼痛杂志》的研究发现，每日补充生姜可以缓解剧烈运动后的肌肉酸痛。

sentences.english: So, how can you use ginger?
It's an incredibly versatile ingredient and can be used in almost anything from tea to biscuits to fiery stir-fries.
sentences.chinese: 它是一种用途极其广泛的食材，几乎可以用于任何食物，从茶到饼干，再到辛辣的炒菜。

sentences.english: Many cafes and supermarkets now sell ginger shots promoting health benefits.
sentences.chinese: 许多咖啡馆和超市现在都出售促进健康的姜汁饮品。

sentences.english: Emily Jonzen, author of The Goodness of Ginger and Turmeric, suggests grating it, though she advises "it has a strong flavour and a fieriness to it so introduce it to your cooking a little at a time".
sentences.chinese: 《生姜和姜黄的益处》一书的作者艾米丽·琼森建议将生姜磨碎，不过她提醒说："它味道浓郁，而且辛辣，所以一次少量地加入你的烹饪中。"

sentences.english: So, if you like the taste, you could incorporate it into your diet and see if you feel these health benefits.
sentences.chinese: 所以，如果你喜欢它的味道，可以将其融入你的饮食中，看看是否能感受到这些健康益处。
